probeRelation.same_project_unrelated_history: The same project with a separate history

connect.title: Connect a repository
connect.description: Connect the project to a repository on GitHub, GitLab or your own server: versions will be kept there and shared with your team.
connect.descriptionFix: The repository did not accept the access. Update the token or key and we will check the connection.
connect.profileFailed: Could not load the version author.

lead.profile: First, introduce yourself: your name and e-mail sign the versions that go to the repository.
lead.repo: Where to send the project versions.
lead.access: How the repository knows it is you. The token or key is stored encrypted on this computer.
lead.accessFix: Enter a new token or add the key to the repository. The address stays the same.
lead.check: Checking that the repository responds and fits this project.

url.label: Repository address
url.hint: Copy the address from the repository page: the Code button on GitHub, Clone on GitLab.
url.tokenStripped: No token is needed in the address: we removed it and did not save it anywhere. Enter the token on the next step.

branch.label: Branch in the repository
branch.hint: Empty: we use the repository's main branch, and create main in an empty repository.

nda.title: The project is marked NDA
nda.text: The repository must be private, and your agreement must allow storing the project files there.
nda.confirm: I have checked the terms: the repository is private and the agreement allows it

sharedFolder.title: The project folder is inside {{provider}}
sharedFolder.text: If the drive syncs both the project files and the .hse-studio/git history, the history can get corrupted. You can still connect the repository, but it is better to exclude this folder from the drive sync.

contents.loading: Counting what goes into the repository…
contents.failed: Could not count the project contents. This does not block the connection.
contents.title: What goes into the repository
contents.pdfNotTracked: Not sent, they can be built again
contents.lfs_one: Found {{count}} Git LFS file. Studio will send only a pointer to it, not the content.
contents.lfs_other: Found {{count}} Git LFS files. Studio will send only pointers to them, not the content.
contents.botAuthored_one: {{count}} earlier version is signed with the shared Studio signature. It goes to the repository as it is, with that signature.
contents.botAuthored_other: {{count}} earlier versions are signed with the shared Studio signature. They go to the repository as they are, with that signature.

overLimit.title_one: {{count}} file is larger than the server limit
overLimit.title_other: {{count}} files are larger than the server limit
overLimit.text: The server will not accept such files, and they are already in the project history. This project cannot be connected to a repository yet: choose a server without such a limit or start a new project without large files.

empty.title: The repository is empty
empty.text: The first sync will upload the project to it.
empty.textWithContents: The first sync will upload the project to it: {{files}}, {{size}}, {{versions}}.

same.title: This project is already in the repository
same.text: Versions from the repository and yours will be merged, nothing gets lost.

new.title: Repository found
new.text: You can connect it. What is inside becomes visible after the first sync.

fix.title: Access works
fix.text: The repository accepted the access. Save it and syncing continues.

notStudio.title: This is not a Studio project
notStudio.text: The repository has no HSE Doc Studio data. Connect an empty repository or one created by Studio.

otherProject.title: The repository holds a different project
otherProject.text: This repository belongs to another Studio project, it cannot be merged with the current one.
otherProject.textNamed: The repository holds a different project: "{{name}}". It cannot be merged with the current one.
otherProject.hint: To work with it, clone the repository into a new folder. Or choose another repository for this project.

unrelated.title: The project and the repository share no history
unrelated.text: It looks like the same project, but the versions there started separately. You can merge both histories: files are combined, and places that differ have to be resolved as conflicts.

warn.schemaNewer: The project in the repository was created by a newer Studio version. You can connect it, but syncing stays paused until you update Studio.
warn.templateMissing: This Studio version does not have the project template: the project will open read-only.

auth_failed.title: The repository did not accept the access
auth_failed.hint: The token is wrong, revoked or expired (or the key has no access to the repository). Check the access and try again.

forbidden_write.title: The access has no write permission
forbidden_write.hint: The repository can be read but versions cannot be sent. Give the token write permission (Contents: Read and write, write_repository) or enable write access for the key.

sso_required.title: The token must be authorized for the organization
sso_required.hint: The organization requires SSO. Open the token settings on the server, authorize it for the organization and check again.

credentials_missing.title: Access is needed
credentials_missing.hint: There is no saved token or key for this repository. Add access on the previous step.

credential_host_mismatch.title: The access was created for another server
credential_host_mismatch.hint: This token or key belongs to a different server. Choose a suitable one or add a new one.

not_found_or_no_access.title: Repository not found or no access
not_found_or_no_access.hint: Check the address. For a private repository the token or key needs access to this very repository.

branch_missing.title: No such branch in the repository
branch_missing.hint: Choose an existing branch or leave the field empty to use the main one.

offline.title: No connection to the server
offline.hint: Check your internet and the address. Versions on this computer are safe, try again later.

timeout.title: The server did not answer in time
timeout.hint: It may be overloaded or the connection is slow. Try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.hint: The server asks you to wait. Check again in a minute.

tls_error.title: The server certificate was rejected
tls_error.hint: The certificate could not be verified. For a corporate server, add the company root certificate to the system and try again.

host_key_unknown.title: Confirm the server
host_key_unknown.hint: This is the first connection to the server. Check its key fingerprint and confirm: ssh will not continue without it.

host_key_changed.title: The server key has changed
host_key_changed.hint: The server used to present a different key. It may be an impersonation, so the connection is stopped.

ssh_unavailable.title: ssh is not installed
ssh_unavailable.hint: Install the OpenSSH client or connect the repository over https with a token.

git_unavailable.title: Git not found
git_unavailable.hint: Install Git or run Studio from an image that includes it.

secrets_unavailable.title: The secret store is unavailable
secrets_unavailable.hint: Tokens and keys cannot be read right now. Check the Studio data folder and its permissions.

store_untrusted.title: The history settings look foreign
store_untrusted.hint: The project history store contains settings that Studio did not create. The connection is stopped for safety.

remote_exists.title: A repository is already connected
remote_exists.hint: Disconnect the current repository in the project settings to connect another one.

url_invalid.title: The address does not fit
url_invalid.hint: The address must look like https://host/owner/repository.git or git@host:owner/repository.git.

url_scheme_forbidden.title: This kind of address is not supported
url_scheme_forbidden.hint: Use https or ssh. Studio does not accept plain http or arbitrary transports.

done.title: Repository connected
done.connectedSyncing: The project is connected to {{repo}}. Starting the first sync.
done.accessUpdated: Access updated: the repository accepted it.
done.syncFailed: The repository is connected, but syncing did not start. Start it from the sync panel.
